verses.text: Judah’s land share, by family, stretched to Edom’s border and south to the Zin wilderness, at the far edge of the South. 🗺️
Its southern border started at the southern bay of the Salt Sea, 🌊
then ran south of the Akrabbim Pass through Zin, south of Kadesh-barnea, past Hezron up to Addar, then turned toward Karka. 🗺️
From there it passed Azmon, reached the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the sea. That was Judah’s southern line. 🌊
The east border was the Salt Sea as far as the Jordan’s end. The north border began at the sea’s bay where the Jordan ends. 🗺️
From there the border went up to Beth-hoglah, passed north of Beth-arabah, and climbed to the Stone of Bohan, Reuben’s son. 🪨
It went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, north toward Gilgal facing the Adummim Pass south of the river, then along to En-shemesh and on to En-rogel. 🗺️
The border climbed through the Valley of Hinnom to the southern edge of Jebusite territory—Jerusalem. It went up to the mountain west of Hinnom Valley, at the north edge of the Rephaim Valley. 🏙️
From the mountain top, the line ran to the spring at Nephtoah, out to the towns of Mount Ephron, and on to Baalah, also called Kiriath-jearim. 🗺️
Then it curved west from Baalah to Mount Seir, passed along the north side of Mount Jearim—also called Chesalon—went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed Timnah. 🏔️
It went out to Ekron’s northern edge, stretched to Shikkeron, passed Mount Baalah, and ended at Jabneel and the sea. 🌊
The Great Sea shore was the west border. That was Judah’s border by family. 🗺️
Joshua gave Caleb son of Jephunneh his share among Judah, just as Yahweh had commanded. It was Kiriath-arba, named after Anak’s father—also called Hebron. 🏘️
Caleb drove out Anak’s three sons: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. ⚔️
Then he went up against the people living in Debir. Debir used to be called Kiriath-sepher. 🏙️
Caleb said, ‘Whoever attacks Kiriath-sepher and takes it can marry my daughter Achsah.’ 🗣️
Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s brother, took the city, so Caleb gave him his daughter Achsah as his wife. 💍
When she arrived, she got Othniel to ask her father for a field. She got down from her donkey, and Caleb asked her, ‘What do you want?’ 🫏
She answered, ‘Give me a blessing. You’ve given me land in the South, so give me springs of water too.’ So Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs. 💧
That was Judah’s inheritance, family by family. 📜
Judah’s southernmost towns near the Edom border were Kabzeel, Eder, and Jagur; 🏘️
Kinah, Dimonah, and Adadah; 🏘️
Kedesh, Hazor, and Ithnan; 🏘️
Ziph, Telem, and Bealoth; 🏘️
Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron—also called Hazor—🏘️
Amam, Shema, and Moladah; 🏘️
Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, and Beth-pelet; 🏘️
Hazar-shual, Beersheba, and Biziothiah; 🏘️
Baalah, Iim, and Ezem; 🏘️
Eltolad, Chesil, and Hormah; 🏘️
Ziklag, Madmannah, and Sansannah; 🏘️
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. That makes twenty-nine towns altogether, plus their villages. 🏘️
In the lowlands: Eshtaol, Zorah, and Ashnah; 🏘️
Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam; 🏘️
Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah; 🏘️
Shaaraim, Adithaim, and Gederah—or Gederothaim. That’s fourteen towns, plus their villages. 🏘️
Zenan, Hadashah, and Migdal-gad; 🏘️
Dilean, Mizpah, and Joktheel; 🏘️
Lachish, Bozkath, and Eglon; 🏘️
Cabbon, Lahmam, and Chitlish; 🏘️
Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah. That’s sixteen towns, plus their villages. 🏘️
Libnah, Ether, and Ashan; 🏘️
Iphtah, Ashnah, and Nezib; 🏘️
Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah. That’s nine towns, plus their villages. 🏘️
Ekron, with all its towns and villages; 🏘️
and from Ekron to the sea, all the settlements beside Ashdod, with their villages. 🌊
Ashdod and all its towns and villages; Gaza and all its towns and villages; as far as the Brook of Egypt and the Great Sea coastline. 🏖️
In the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, and Socoh; 🏘️
Dannah and Kiriath-sannah—also called Debir—🏘️
Anab, Eshtemoh, and Anim; 🏘️
Goshen, Holon, and Giloh. That’s eleven towns, plus their villages. 🏘️
Arab, Dumah, and Eshan; 🏘️
Janim, Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah; 🏘️
Humtah, Kiriath-arba—also called Hebron—and Zior. That’s nine towns, plus their villages. 🏘️
Maon, Carmel, Ziph, and Jutah; 🏘️
Jezreel, Jokdeam, and Zanoah; 🏘️
Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah. That’s ten towns, plus their villages. 🏘️
Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor; 🏘️
Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon. That’s six towns, plus their villages. 🏘️
Kiriath-baal—also called Kiriath-jearim—and Rabbah. That’s two towns, plus their villages. 🏘️
Out in the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah; 🏜️
Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi. That’s six towns, plus their villages. 🏜️
But Judah couldn’t drive the Jebusites out of Jerusalem. The Jebusites still live there among Judah’s people to this day. 🏙️
